title: Cuba's Diaz-Canel says there are no current talks with US after Trump threats
summary: Cuban President Miguel Diaz-Canel said that there were no ongoing discussions between Havana and Washington after US President Donald Trump claimed to be "talking to Cuba". Trump had earlier warned the Cuban government to "make a deal' before it was "too late", having pledged to cut off all Venezuelan oil or money going to the Caribbean nation.
